2608.14063.title: Benchmarking data-driven material models on the classic Treloar dataset
2608.14063.paper_summary: Machine learning is rapidly reshaping constitutive modeling, offers new ways to learn material behavior directly from experimental data, and challenges long-established modeling paradigms. But with a growing number of machine-learning-based approaches available, how do they compare in practice? In this paper, we use the classic experimental data of Treloar to benchmark popular frameworks for hyperelasticity: (Generalized-Invariant) Constitutive Artificial Neural Networks, Physics-Augmented Neural Networks, (Adaptive) Material Fingerprinting, and Efficient Unsupervised Constitutive Law Identification & Discovery. We compare their fitting performance, computational cost, hyperparameter sensitivity, and ease of implementation. Furthermore, we discuss the trade-offs between predictive accuracy and model complexity. The latter is assessed by quantifying both the number of material parameters in the discovered models and the computational time required to evaluate the constitutive model and its derivatives. The results show that all methods can reproduce the benchmark data remarkably well. Rather than identifying a single winner, we highlight the strengths and limitations of each approach and provide practical guidance for their use. The source code for all six methods, including the training and comparison scripts, as well as all results and data used in this study, is publicly available via https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21915635.
2608.14063.paper_summary_zh: 機器學習正在迅速重塑本構模型，提供了從實驗數據中直接學習材料行為的新方法，並挑戰了長期以來建立的建模範式。<lb/>但隨著越來越多基於機器學習的方法可用，它們在實踐中的比較如何？<lb/>在本文中，我們使用Treloar的經典實驗數據來基準流行的超彈性框架： (廣義不變) 本構人工神經網絡、物理增強神經網絡、(自適應) 材料指紋識別，以及高效無監督本構法律識別與發現。<lb/>我們比較了它們的擬合性能、計算成本、超參數敏感性和實施的便利性。<lb/>此外，我們討論了預測準確性與模型複雜性之間的權衡。<lb/>後者通過量化所發現模型中的材料參數數量以及評估本構模型及其導數所需的計算時間來進行評估。<lb/>結果顯示，所有方法都能相當好地重現基準數據。<lb/>我們不僅僅是確定一個單一的勝者，而是突顯每種方法的優勢和局限性，並提供實用的使用指導。<lb/>所有六種方法的源代碼，包括訓練和比較腳本，以及本研究中使用的所有結果和數據，均可通過 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21915635 公開獲取。
